diagnostic: Post-hoc allocation and eviction timing audit for the saved robust-bank W32 formal traces.

definitions.true_context_switch: An index where the observer-only context_id changes; adjacent scheduled segments with the same context are not treated as a switch.
definitions.steps_after_switch: For a transition at index i, i - latest_true_switch_index + 1; the first transition after a switch counts as 1. Stream start is the initial boundary.
definitions.late_event_thresholds: Strictly more than 64 or 128 completed transitions after the latest true context switch.
definitions.previous_8_steps_for_band: The eight completed transitions immediately before allocation/eviction index i (indices max(0, i-8) through i-1); the current post-action transition is reported separately.
definitions.new_band_entry: A transition into an x band not previously observed during the current contiguous true-context run.
definitions.pre_action_cell_status: Uses the logged slot and untried_action. A resolved route with untried_action=false means at least one prior observation in that band/action cell, not proof of a contradiction. For slot=-1 unresolved routes, support is unknown even though the trace's fallback untried_action is true.

generation_reuse_lost_to_eviction_diagno.interpretation: An evicted generation cannot recur under its generation ID. These are post-hoc future-revisit opportunities; another slot may preserve a profile, and a fresh generation may be allocated later. Counts are correlational, not causal evidence that an eviction caused a missed reuse.

trace_limits.contradiction_vs_novel_cell_classificati: Not directly logged. Resolved-route cell status only distinguishes at least one prior observation from no prior observation; unresolved route rows have unknown active-profile support.

known_slot_reuse_vs_novelty_evidence_as_.known_profile_reuse: 2 matching events across at least 2 cells; each matching slot cell needs support >=2 and predictive probability >=0.60.
known_slot_reuse_vs_novelty_evidence_as_.new_profile_from_active_bank: 3 novelty events across at least 2 cells; a contradiction is triggered at cell support >=1 and predictive probability <0.30.
known_slot_reuse_vs_novelty_evidence_as_.assessment: This is asymmetric evidence: a new profile can be confirmed from sparse one-sample support per cell, while known-profile matching requires at least two samples. The source logic can therefore confuse partial cell profiles with new tasks. The saved trace lacks observe-time reason/probability, so the formal run cannot establish that this mechanism caused the observed splits.
